property_summary: After a caller with zero kilos uses getFreeKilo and waits exactly one day before a single collectDrugs call, Kilos[caller] must equal exactly 2*STARTING_KILOS (one day's production = STARTING_KILOS kilos added once); the mutant doubles the daily increment, yielding 3*STARTING_KILOS.
change_summary: Double the number of new kilos added per collect, so Kilos[msg.sender] grows twice as fast as in P.
